Check metadata.truncated and metadata.pagination; continue long threads
with get_thread_posts(thread_id, offset=next_offset).

tools.description:
Read a page of visible posts in a WindowsForum thread, oldest first.
Follow pagination.next_offset while pagination.has_more to read the
full conversation, including later replies and accepted solutions.

tools.name: search_mysql
tools.description:
Exact substring lookup over thread titles and author usernames, ordered by view count — use for literal title or author matching rather than relevance-ranked full-text search.

Complements the main `search` tool: use this for literal title or author

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Get a WindowsForum thread's metadata by id — title, author, reply and view counts, dates, and canonical URL; use fetch or get_thread_posts to read its content.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List the newest WindowsForum threads, news articles or tutorials, newest first, with no search query — use when the user asks for the latest, newest or most recent tutorials, news or threads. Pass each item's `id` to render_search_results to show them as a card.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get a single WindowsForum post by post id — returns the post's text, author, thread context, and URL; use when you have a specific post reference to verify or quote.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description:
Look up a WindowsForum member's public profile by username or user id — registration date, message count, reaction score, last seen, and profile URL.

returned: members who limit their profile get a username-only result,
and la

tools.name: get_forum
tools.description: Get a WindowsForum forum section's details by node id — title, description, and thread/message counts; pair with list_threads or get_forum_updates to see its activity.

tools.name: get_forum_updates
tools.description: Summarize recent WindowsForum activity over the last N hours (default 24) — new threads and posts across the community; use for "what's new" questions.

tools.name: get_online_users
tools.description: See who is on WindowsForum right now — counts of members, guests, and robots active in the last 15 minutes, with the names of online members who show their online status.

tools.name: get_latest_registered_users
tools.description:
List the newest WindowsForum member registrations — use for community-growth questions or to identify recent joiners.

Only confirmed, non-banned accounts are listed, as on the forum's own
"New members" list.

tools.name: get_forum_statistics
tools.description: Get sitewide WindowsForum statistics — total threads, posts, and members, plus threads and posts created today; use for questions about the community's size and activity.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search individual WindowsForum posts (not just thread titles) for a keyword or phrase — use to find specific answers, error messages, or fixes buried inside long threads.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Find WindowsForum members whose usernames match a query — use to locate a member before calling get_user for their full profile.

tools.name: get_windows_news_posts
tools.description: Get WindowsForum's recent Windows news coverage from the last N days (default 7) — curated news threads on updates, security patches, and Microsoft announcements.

tools.name: render_search_results
tools.description: Show WindowsForum threads, news articles, tutorials or posts to the user as a result card, grouped by section. tools.name: render_thread
tools.description: Show a WindowsForum thread to the user as a readable card with its opening post and replies. Use after search or fetch when the user wants to see or open a specific discussion.

tools.name: render_kb_article
tools.description: Show an official Microsoft Knowledge Base article to the user as a card with its title, highlights, and link to support.microsoft.com. Use when the user asks to see a specific KB article.

tools.name: render_community_overview
tools.description: Show a WindowsForum.com community overview card: total threads, posts, and members, who is online now, and the latest threads. Use for questions about the community's size or current activity.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_threads" is 1263 chars, far longer than this server's median (203). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_users" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find WindowsForum members whose usernames match a query — use to locate a member before calling get_user for their full profile.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.windowsforum.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_threads, supplement_status, list_drifted, get_kb_article, search_kb, get_thread_posts, search_mysql, search_elastic, get_thread, list_threads, get_post, get_user, get_forum, get_forum_updates, get_forum_statistics, search_posts, get_windows_news_posts, render_search_results, render_thread · Private data: search, fetch, search_threads · Public sink: search_semantic, list_drifted, get_post, render_thread · Destructive: corpus_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_threads, supplement_status, list_drifted, get_kb_article, search_kb, get_thread_posts, search_mysql, search_elastic, get_thread, list_threads, get_post, get_user, get_forum, get_forum_updates, get_forum_statistics, search_posts, get_windows_news_posts, render_search_results, render_thread · Private data: search, fetch, search_threads · Public sink: search_semantic, list_drifted, get_post, render_thread · Destructive: corpus_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
